audit_note_1_actionable_gap_precision.operational_characterization: Sensitive screening filter rather than an autonomous teacher-facing alarm. While all true gaps (FN=0) were captured, the 10 false-positive warnings necessitate human-in-the-loop review before surfacing alerts to instructors.

audit_note_2_bfs_conceptual_boundary_sub.analysis: Human raters credited a brief verbal remark regarding unweighted graphs as Level 3 boundary coverage. P5.3 found insufficient evidence in the reconstructed concepts/episodes and scored it at Level 0 (NOT_OBSERVED). The causal isolation test between pkg_03 and pkg_04 demonstrates objective conditioning sensitivity, but must NOT be claimed as proving error-free diagnosis on all conceptual dimensions.

audit_note_4_sdb_conservatism_interpreta.status: Empirical observation, not proven causal mechanism
audit_note_4_sdb_conservatism_interpreta.interpretation: Negative SDB reflects a measured systematic negative offset relative to human raters. Qualitative synthesis text frequently notes absence of step derivations or code traces, but attributing this entirely to formal model demands remains a working hypothesis subject to further ablation.
